data.name: Yashraj
data.gender_notes: Yashraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Yashraj is derived from two Sanskrit words - Yash (meaning success, victory, fame) and Raj (meaning king, ruler, power). The name signifies a powerful leader who has achieved success and victory in life. The name Yashraj carries the meaning “Lord of success” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Yashraj usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of success and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Yashraj is believed to invoke the blessings of Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe and the god of success, wealth, and prosperity. It is also believed that the name connects the bearer with the divine energy of success and courage.
data.etymology: Yashraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of success.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yashraj total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Yashraj is a popular one in Hindu culture, as it embodies the values of power, success, and victory. It is a name that inspires ambition and motivation, as it suggests the potential for great accomplishments in life. In Hindu mythology, there are numerous gods and goddesses who are depicted as kings and rulers of various realms, and the name Yashraj may be seen as an homage to this tradition. The name is also a source of pride and recognition for families and communities, as it implies a connection to a long lineage of successful and powerful leaders.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Yashraj can be seen as a reminder of the power of the divine in one's life. The name suggests that success and victory come not through one's own efforts alone, but through the grace and blessings of the divine. It encourages one to trust in the power of the universe and to remain humble and grateful in the face of success. The name also reminds one of the importance of leadership and service to others, as a true king or ruler is one who serves and protects his subjects with wisdom and compassion. Ultimately, the name Yashraj offers a powerful combination of worldly and spiritual values, encouraging one to strive for success and power while remaining grounded in the principles of humility, gratitude, and service.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Yashraj: One who brings fame and success through righteous deeds and actions. Radiating victory and triumph, their light inspires and uplifts others.

historical_references.reference: Yashraj was a legendary king of the Yadava dynasty who ruled over Mathura during the Late Harappan period (around 2600 BCE). He is mentioned in the Rigveda as a chief of the Vrshni clan and is revered for his virtue and martial prowess.

Another reference to Yashraj is found in the Mahabharata, an epic poem of ancient India. He is mentioned as a descendant of the Yadava dynasty and a kinsman of Krishna. Yashraj is also known as the father of Prasenajit, the king of Kashmir who played an important role in the Kurukshetra war.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Yashraj is synonymous with Bollywood and is known as the leading film production house in India, Yash Raj Films (YRF). With a strong presence in the Indian film industry, YRF has also expanded its footprint to Television and Digital Streaming platforms. On Television, they produce content for channels like Star Plus and Colors. On Digital Streaming platforms like Amazon Prime Video and Netflix, they have produced popular shows such as Mirzapur and Scam 1992. The trend is towards creating engaging and high-quality content across various mediums to cater to the diverse needs and preferences of audiences.
